message.content: In the conversation dated 20260707, LiHua expresses concern about the basement following recent rainstorms, asking Adam if there were any issues. She specifically wants to ensure that everything in the basement is okay after the storms. In response, Adam confirms that everything seems fine in the basement but advises LiHua to keep an eye on it and informs her that he will call in the maintenance worker if any issues arise. This indicates that while there were no immediate problems detected, the area requires ongoing monitoring to address any potential damage caused by the rainstorms. LiHua appreciates Adam’s reassurance and plans to stay vigilant herself, further emphasizing the ongoing concern for the basement's condition.
